parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT '{{ $json.run_id }}'::text AS run_id
),
inst AS (
  SELECT i.uniqueref       AS instrument_ref,
         c.concept_name    AS instrument_model
  FROM params p
  LEFT JOIN instruments i
    ON i.serial_number = split_part(p.run_id, '_', 2)
  LEFT JOIN concepts c
    ON c.uniqueref = i.instrument_concept_ref
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO runs (run_id, instrument_ref)
  SELECT p.run_id, ins.instrument_ref
  FROM params p CROSS JOIN inst ins
  ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT i.*, ins.instrument_model
FROM inserted i CROSS JOIN inst ins
UNION ALL
SELECT r.*, ins.instrument_model
FROM runs r
CROSS JOIN inst ins
CROSS JOIN params p
WHERE r.run_id = p.run_id
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted);

parameters.command: =  xml_file="{{ $('Start').item.json.path }}RunParameters.xml"; lot=$(sed -n 's/.*<FlowCellLotNumber>\([^<]*\)<\/FlowCellLotNumber>.*/\1/p' "$xml_file" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$lot" ] && lot=$(awk '/<ConsumableInfo>/{in_block=1;block=""}in_block{block=block $0 "\n"}/<\/ConsumableInfo>/{if(block~/<Type>FlowCell<\/Type>/){match(block,/<LotNumber>([^<]+)<\/LotNumber>/,arr);print arr[1];exit}in_block=0}' "$xml_file" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$lot" ] && lot=$(awk '/<FlowCellRfidTag>/,/<\/FlowCellRfidTag>/{if(/<LotNumber>/){match($0,/<LotNumber>([^<]+)<\/LotNumber>/,arr);print arr[1];exit}}' "$xml_file" 2>/dev/null); echo "$lot"

=xml_file="{{ $('Start').item.json.path }}RunParameters.xml"
# NovaSeq X Plus: RecipeName present, no FlowCellMode
if grep -q '<RecipeName>' "$xml_file" 2>/dev/null && ! grep -q '<FlowCellMode' "$xml_file" 2>/dev/null; then
  recipe=$(grep -oP '<RecipeName>\K[^<]+' "$xml_file" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  if [ -n "$recipe" ]; then
    echo "$recipe"
    exit 0
  fi
fi
# NovaSeq 6000 / NextSeq fallback (original logic)
fc=$(grep -oP '<FlowCellMode[^>]*>\K[^<]+' "$xml_file" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
cyc=$(grep -oP '<CartridgeMode[^>]*>[^<]*\(\K[0-9]+(?= Cycles\))' "$xml_file" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
# NextSeq 1000/2000 reagent cartridge cycle count -> reagent kit nomenclature
case "$cyc" in
  122) kit_cyc="100 Cycles" ;;
  222) kit_cyc="200 Cycles" ;;
  338) kit_cyc="300 Cycles" ;;
  638) kit_cyc="600 Cycles" ;;
  *)   kit_cyc="" ;;
esac
if [ -n "$kit_cyc" ] && [ -n "$fc" ]; then
  echo "$fc ($kit_cyc)"
else
  echo "$fc"
fi

  '{{ $('Start').item.json.run_id }}' AS run_id,
  '{{ $('Start').item.json.path }}' AS path,

    FROM measurement_run mr
    JOIN runs r ON r.uniqueref = mr.run_ref

JOIN instruments i ON i.uniqueref = r.instrument_ref
